review_scope: Nine-path read-only release acceptance preflight: pure observation evaluator, explicit-file CLI, focused tests, CLI manuals, bilingual contract and this review record. The review does not cover the actual provider, manual terminal, tag, Release, upload or public install gates.
goal: Make the remaining 1.2 release evidence classes explicit and machine-checkable only from caller-supplied observations, without invoking or implying any external gate.
not_doing: No real provider or paid call
No wheel build, tag, Release, package upload or public install
No authority to treat supplied evidence as re-executed proof
No release-ledger or release-1.2 publication-status change

findings.reason: The fresh-context review observed that the CLI success tests created temporary files and called the descriptor-relative reader without a POSIX capability skip. On the Windows matrix those tests would fail as unsupported_platform rather than exercising the advertised command. The test class now declares the same O_DIRECTORY/O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK plus dir_fd guard used by evidence verification; a focused unsupported-platform regression calls the production seam with an emptied dir_fd set and receives refused/unsupported_platform.

The reviewer reproduced that report_sha256 was first computed by the evaluator, then verify_release_acceptance added source_sha256 without recomputing it. A reader recomputing the documented canonical digest over the emitted report failed. The verification seam now attaches source_sha256, removes only report_sha256, recomputes over every remaining field and rechecks the report budget. A real-file CLI regression and a focused verification regression both recompute the digest successfully.

C: The report has fixed gate order and separates satisfied, pending/not_run, unknown and failed. Missing later evidence and a supplied blocker remain different states; a blocker is accepted only for a gate with no evidence.

C: Input parsing is closed and bounded to 64 KiB. Unsafe paths, symlinks, non-regular files, duplicate JSON keys, non-finite numbers, excessive nesting, invalid digests, wrong version/tag/CI count, duplicate blockers and blocker/evidence overlap are refused.
C: Provider/model/operator/tag/action text is validated but omitted from output. The report states supplied_observations and files_rechecked=false.
C: The CLI reads only one explicit file and never calls provider/network/publication. Unsupported descriptor primitives return refused/unsupported_platform.

F: Fresh-context review initially ran read-only and could not create temporary directories, so its execution-dependent probes were limited. It still found the two major defects above by static inspection and in-memory checks; no independent CI or product-main evidence was produced.
